investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ridgepath Education (online learning); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/eu-central-1b/eu-central-1c); network range 10.148.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ridgep-prod-eucent (EKS); auth-svc pods run with 4 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
